gizmoDescription: Kani wuxuu soo bandhigi karaa fiidiyaha si daboolan xad-dhaaf ah iyada oo aan loo eegayn asalka.
endTimeDescription: Jooji fiidiyaha waqti gaar ah (ilbiriqsi), wuxuu u baahan yahay waqti bilaabid.
learningModeDescription: Wuxuu damiyyaa dhaqaajinta sare iyo dib-u-jeedinta.
hideYoutubeLinkDescription: Wuxuu ka saaraa batoonka furaha fiidiyaha ee YouTube.
crossoriginDescription: Wuxuu muujinayaa in la isticmaalo CORS.
allowBackgroundPlayDescription: Fiidiyoyinka way istaagaan/daabacaan si toos ah marka tab-ka diirada laga qaado; tani waxay u oggolaaneysaa fiidiyaha in uu dhaadho iyada oo tab-ku aanu lahayn diirada
disableInteractiveDescription: Na xidh qaab isdhaaf ah kaas oo dhigaya qoraalka la taaban karo.
accentColorDescription: (ha loo isticmaalin) Dooro midabka caanaha ee daareeha.
